assets.notes: KayKit Adventurers Barbarian. Rig boneCount=41 (inspector bones list truncated at 40). Weapon attachment bones: handslotr (right) / handslotl (offhand), lowercase. Ships with toggleable prop meshes parented to slots (1H_Axe, 1H_Axe_Offhand, 2H_Axe, Barbarian_Round_Shield, Mug, Barbarian_Hat, Barbarian_Cape) - set .visible=false on unwanted props at load. Clip mapping: idle=Idle, walk=Walking_A/B/C, run=Running_A/B, melee=1H/2H/Unarmed_Melee_Attack_*, death=Death_A (0.8s)/Death_B (2.63s) with _Pose end states. Faces +Z; bbox x inflated by T-pose arms.

Static sword prop (no animations/bones), repacked from pack gltf+bin to self-contained glb. Blade points +Y, grip at origin - parent directly under a KayKit handslotr bone with identity transform; native scale matches the character pack.

KayKit Adventurers Mage as old-man chief. boneCount=41 (bones list truncated at 40). Hide prop meshes Spellbook, Spellbook_open, 1H_Wand, 2H_Staff for civilian look. Use Idle + Walking_A. bbox inflated by attached props (hat/cape/staff). Faces +Z.

KayKit Adventurers Knight as blacksmith (distinct from player Barbarian). boneCount=41 (bones list truncated at 40). Hide prop meshes 1H_Sword, 1H_Sword_Offhand, 2H_Sword, Badge_Shield, Rectangle_Shield, Round_Shield, Spike_Shield; optionally hide Knight_Helmet to show head. Interact (1.3s) works as hammering placeholder.
KayKit Adventurers Rogue (no hood) as generic villager. boneCount=41 (bones list truncated at 40). Hide prop meshes Knife, Knife_Offhand, 1H_Crossbow, 2H_Crossbow, Throwable for commoner look.

KayKit Skeleton Warrior, 95 embedded clips. boneCount=41 (bones list truncated at 40). Mapping: idle=Idle/Idle_Combat, walk=Walking_A or shamble Walking_D_Skeletons, attack=1H_Melee_Attack_Slice_Diagonal/Chop, death=Death_A/Death_B; flavor: Skeletons_Awaken_Floor spawn, Death_C_Skeletons_Resurrect. ~2.7 units tall (scale ~0.6-0.7 vs 1.8m humans). Faces +Z. No weapon mesh embedded - attach draugr_weapon_skeleton_blade.glb to handslotr.

KayKit Skeleton Mage, same 95-clip rig as warrior (verified identical by inspector). boneCount=41 (bones list truncated at 40). Mapping: idle=Idle, walk=Walking_A, attack=Spellcast_Shoot (or Spellcast_Long/Spellcast_Summon), death=Death_A/Death_B. Same scale/orientation as warrior.
Static Skeleton_Blade prop (no animations/bones), repacked to self-contained glb. Attach as child of skeleton handslotr bone with identity transform.

Quaternius wolf. CM-SCALE EXPORT: bbox ~270 units long, scale ~0.01 for meters; bbox.y=527 inflated by rest-pose bone extents. boneCount=51 (bones list truncated at 40). Every clip exists twice (plain + AnimalArmature| prefix, same data) - 24 clips total, use either set. run=Gallop, attack=Attack, death=Death.

Quaternius Dragon Evolved boss. All clip names prefixed CharacterArmature|. CM-SCALE: ~492 units wide, apply scale ~0.01-0.02. boneCount=46 (bones list truncated at 40). Mapping: hover=Flying_Idle, flight=Fast_Flying, attacks=Headbutt/Punch, HitReact, Death. Faces +Z. Earlier 0-byte download was replaced; current file validates ok.
Stylized pine, 8.7 units tall, roughly meter-scale, usable near 1:1. Embedded texture, 2 materials.
Stylized pine, 7.4 units tall, narrower silhouette than pine_01 for shape variety.
Snow-capped pine for nordic look. Only 3.3 units tall - smaller native scale, scale up ~2x to match other pines.
Small boulder ~0.6 units - scale up 2-4x for scatter rocks.
Large flat-ish boulder ~7.7 units wide - landmark/cover rock.
